scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: An item price
scenes.caption: Decision Lab sketch kits cost ₹240 each. Aditi needs kits for a small group. Vihaan records the unit price, leaving space for quantity and charges before calculating a final bill.
scenes.speech: Decision Lab sketch kits cost ₹240 each. Aditi needs kits for a small group. Vihaan records the unit price, leaving space for quantity and charges before calculating a final bill.
scenes.dialogue: A unit price needs a quantity.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Build the base total
scenes.caption: The supplied basket contains 3 kits, a mandatory delivery charge of ₹45 and a mandatory handling charge of ₹15. No other charge or discount applies. Aditi calculates the item subtotal, then adds stated charges with each line visible.
scenes.speech: The supplied basket contains 3 kits, a mandatory delivery charge of ₹45 and a mandatory handling charge of ₹15. No other charge or discount applies. Aditi calculates the item subtotal, then adds stated charges with each line visible.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A checked extra
scenes.caption: A storage pouch is already selected at ₹90 for the whole basket. Vihaan places this optional line away from the mandatory charges. A checked box shows basket state, without establishing deliberate choice or understanding of price.
scenes.speech: A storage pouch is already selected at ₹90 for the whole basket. Vihaan places this optional line away from the mandatory charges. A checked box shows basket state, without establishing deliberate choice or understanding of price.
scenes.dialogue: Inspect the default before accepting it.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Make a deliberate choice
scenes.caption: The learner compares the basket with and without the pouch. Their teacher asks them to explain whether the group needs it, rather than assuming every extra is fraudulent. They can pause purchasing while privately reconciling quantity and costs.
scenes.speech: The learner compares the basket with and without the pouch. Their teacher asks them to explain whether the group needs it, rather than assuming every extra is fraudulent. They can pause purchasing while privately reconciling quantity and costs.
scenes.dialogue: A choice needs an understood consequence.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Remove the pouch
scenes.caption: Aditi removes the optional pouch in the paper simulation. The mandatory charges remain because their terms have not changed. Vihaan checks that the total falls by the pouch price, without drawing unsupported legal conclusions.
scenes.speech: Aditi removes the optional pouch in the paper simulation. The mandatory charges remain because their terms have not changed. Vihaan checks that the total falls by the pouch price, without drawing unsupported legal conclusions.
scenes.dialogue: Removing one line does not remove every charge.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Record the actual terms
scenes.caption: The final displayed amount without the pouch is ₹780. Their price and consent record keeps the advertisement, quantity, mandatory fees and removed extra together. Later changes require another comparison before purchasing, even when the headline looks attractive.
scenes.speech: The final displayed amount without the pouch is ₹780. Their price and consent record keeps the advertisement, quantity, mandatory fees and removed extra together. Later changes require another comparison before purchasing, even when the headline looks attractive.
scenes.dialogue: Document the terms you actually reviewed.
